authors: C. Fabre, S. Haroche, P. Goy
title: Millimeter spectroscopy in sodium Rydberg states: Quantum-defect, fine-structure, and polarizability measurements
method: atomic-beam millimeter-wave spectroscopy with free-running BWO, wavemeter, selective field ionization
uncertainty: +-0.06 GHz except 23S-24S and 28D-29D (+-0.03 GHz); fine structure 18-30 MHz
conversion: Not exported, fine structure not resolved (no J): 11 rows (23S-24S, 23S-23P, 24S-23P, 29D-31P, 28D-29F, 29D-28F, 28D-29D, 33S-34P, ...).
caveats: Low precision (+-60 MHz), fine structure of P levels not resolved in Table I (fine-structure-free positions).
Two-photon lines are given as 2 x (frequency): the value column holds the frequency inside the brackets.
28D-29D is a nominally forbidden single-photon Delta l=0 line made allowed by stray-field Stark mixing (p. 233); it may carry a Stark shift.
